what: Convent of devotees founded by the Sanyasi Harinath at the island rock; first mahant; Digambar, Buchanan-Hamilton's mahant, thirteenth in succession; Ananta (early 19th c.) built most of the buildings. Order called "Sanyasi" only; no Giri/Puri etc. named, so DASNAMI is inferred from the word Sanyasi (medium). Gazetteer does not name the rock as Ghaibnath in the text read; Jahangira is described separately (p.38-39).
quote: a devotee or Sanyasi named Harinath ... founding a convent of devotees, he became its first mahant or abbot

what: Mahant succession: no young man can hope to aspire to the dignity.
quote: the thirteenth who had enjoyed that dignity, to which no young man can hope to aspire

what: Pilgrims bathe and carry Ganges water to the temple; Jahangira holy as a northern bend (uttara vahini) of the Ganges; ascetic orders not mentioned.
quote: Almost everyone who comes to bathe at Sultanganj visits the temple, and carries up a vessel of water

what: An ascetic living on the hill supplies visitors with lamps; order not stated.
quote: An ascetic residing on the hill, however, supplies visitors with lamps
